func _jump_to_world_inputs() -> void:
	if player == null or world_x_input == null or world_y_input == null:
		return
	var target_cell := Vector2i(
		clamp(int(world_x_input.text), 0, max(0, active_map_w - 1)),
		clamp(int(world_y_input.text), 0, max(0, active_map_h - 1))
	)
	player.position = Vector2(
		target_cell.x * active_cell_px + active_cell_px * 0.5,
		target_cell.y * active_cell_px + active_cell_px * 0.5
	)
	_update_runtime_camera_layout()
	if interaction_hint_label != null:
		var tile := _world_tile_for_cell(target_cell)
		if tile.is_empty():
			interaction_hint_label.text = "Arrived at X%d Y%d" % [target_cell.x, target_cell.y]
		else:
			interaction_hint_label.text = "Arrived at X%d Y%d | #%d %s" % [
				target_cell.x,
				target_cell.y,
				int(tile.get("order", 0)),
				_ascii_ui_text(String(tile.get("name", "")), "Map"),
			]

func _open_map_editor() -> void:
	if OS.has_feature("web"):
		JavaScriptBridge.eval("location.href='http://127.0.0.1:8794/web/index.html?build=runtime-ui-return-' + Date.now()", true)
	else:
		OS.shell_open(ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://web/index.html"))

func _ascii_ui_text(value: String, fallback: String) -> String:
	if value.is_empty():
		return fallback
	for i in value.length():
		if value.unicode_at(i) > 127:
			return fallback
	return value

func _atlas_custom(path: String, region: Rect2) -> AtlasTexture:
	var key := "%s:%s" % [path, region]
	if atlas_cache.has(key):
		return atlas_cache[key]
	var tex := AtlasTexture.new()
	tex.atlas = _texture(path)
	tex.region = region
	tex.filter_clip = true
	atlas_cache[key] = tex
	return tex

func _texture(path: String) -> Texture2D:
	if atlas_cache.has(path):
		return atlas_cache[path]
	var texture: Texture2D = null
	if OS.has_feature("web"):
		texture = load(path) as Texture2D
	else:
		var image := Image.new()
		var err := image.load(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(path))
		if err == OK:
			_normalize_texture_alpha(path, image)
			texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)
		else:
			texture = load(path) as Texture2D
	if texture == null:
		push_error("Missing texture: " + path)
	elif _needs_edge_alpha_cleanup(path):
		var imported_image := texture.get_image()
		if imported_image != null and not imported_image.is_empty():
			_normalize_texture_alpha(path, imported_image)
			texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(imported_image)
	atlas_cache[path] = texture
	return texture

   [scripts/main.gd](/Users/vincet/Documents/aiglass/GameGmeta/scripts/main.gd:3688)

        if (isLand) landCells.push({ x, y, variant });
      }
    }
    landCells.sort((a, b) => (a.y - b.y) || (a.x - b.x));
    if (landCells.length < mapCount) {
      cols += 4;
      rows = Math.ceil(cols * 0.56);
    }
  }
  return { cols, rows, landCells, terrainCells };
}

  return PURPOSE_BASE_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => purpose.startsWith(prefix));

function isBaseTerrainAsset(asset) {
  return Boolean(asset && isBaseTerrainPurpose(assetPurpose(asset)));

function defaultTile() {
  return (

    ASSETS.find((asset) => asset.package === "tiny-town" && asset.mode === "tile") ||
    ASSETS.find((asset) => asset.mode === "tile" && /grass|terrain|green/i.test(`${asset.id} ${asset.name}`)) ||

    ASSETS[0]
  );
}

function buildBoard() {
  board.innerHTML = "";
  cells.length = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y += 1) {
    for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x += 1) {
      const cell = document.createElement("button");
      cell.type = "button";
      cell.className = "grid-cell";
      cell.dataset.x = String(x);
      cell.dataset.y = String(y);
      cell.style.left = `${x * CELL}px`;
      cell.style.top = `${y * CELL}px`;
      cell.title = `${x}, ${y}`;
      cell.addEventListener("click", () => placeSelected(x, y));
      cell.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        cell.classList.add("drop-target");
      });
      cell.addEventListener("dragleave", () => cell.classList.remove("drop-target"));
      cell.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        cell.classList.remove("drop-target");
        const asset = assetById(event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain"));
        if (asset) placeAsset(asset, x, y);
      });
      board.appendChild(cell);
      cells.push(cell);
    }
  }
}

function renderTerrain() {
  for (const cell of cells) {
    const x = Number(cell.dataset.x);
    const y = Number(cell.dataset.y);
    const asset = assetById(terrain[y][x]) || defaultTile();
    cell.style.backgroundImage = asset ? `url("${assetUrl(asset)}")` : "";
  }
}

function buildPackageSelect() {
  const assets = visibleLibraryAssets();
  const counts = new Map();
  for (const asset of assets) counts.set(asset.package, (counts.get(asset.package) || 0) + 1);
  packageSelect.innerHTML = "";
  const all = document.createElement("option");
  all.value = "全部";
  all.textContent = `全部素材包 (${assets.length})`;
  packageSelect.appendChild(all);

  for (const pack of PACKAGES) {
    const count = counts.get(pack.name) || 0;
    if (count === 0) continue;
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = pack.name;
    option.textContent = `${pack.name} (${count})`;
    packageSelect.appendChild(option);
  }
  if (activePackage !== "全部" && !assets.some((asset) => asset.package === activePackage)) activePackage = "全部";

}

  const rect = board.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = Math.floor((event.clientX - rect.left) / CELL);
  const y = Math.floor((event.clientY - rect.top) / CELL);
  if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= COLS || y >= ROWS) return;

  const stampId = Number(event.dataTransfer.getData("application/x-stamp-id"));
  if (stampId) {
    const stamp = stamps.find((item) => item.id === stampId);
    if (!stamp) return;
    const asset = assetById(stamp.assetId);
    if (!asset) return;
    const origin = clampOrigin(asset, x, y);
    const removed = removeOverlappingStamps({
      x: origin.x,
      y: origin.y,
      w: Math.max(1, stamp.w),
      h: Math.max(1, stamp.h),
    }, stamp.id);
    stamp.x = origin.x;
    stamp.y = origin.y;
    selectedStampId = stamp.id;
    renderStamps();
    statusText.textContent = removed > 0
      ? `已移动 ${asset.name}，并替换 ${removed} 个上层素材：${origin.x}, ${origin.y}`
      : `已移动 ${asset.name}：${origin.x}, ${origin.y}`;
    return;
  }

  const asset = assetById(event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain"));
  if (asset) placeAsset(asset, x, y);
});

function worldLandLayout(mapCount) {
  let cols = Math.max(24, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, mapCount) * 2.2)));
  let rows = Math.max(16, Math.ceil(cols * 0.68));
  let landCells = [];
  while (landCells.length < mapCount) {
    landCells = [];
    const centerX = (cols - 1) / 2;
    const centerY = (rows - 1) / 2;
    const radiusX = Math.max(1, cols * 0.42);
    const radiusY = Math.max(1, rows * 0.36);
    for (let y = 0; y < rows; y += 1) {
      for (let x = 0; x < cols; x += 1) {
        const dx = (x - centerX) / radiusX;
        const dy = (y - centerY) / radiusY;

        if ((dx * dx + dy * dy) < 1.0 + bulge) {

async function loadLibrary() {
  loadHiddenLibraryAssets();
  const response = await fetch(`${MANIFEST_URL}?v=${encodeURIComponent(ASSET_CACHE_KEY)}`);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`无法读取 Kenney manifest: ${response.status}`);
  const manifest = await response.json();
  ASSETS = tinyOnlyAssets(manifest.assets || []);
  PACKAGES = tinyOnlyPackages(manifest.packages || [], ASSETS);
  if (!PACKAGES.some((pack) => pack.name === activePackage)) activePackage = PACKAGES[0]?.name || "全部";
  const visibleCount = visibleLibraryAssets().length;
  assetLibraryMeta.textContent = `Tiny、AI 与收藏素材 ${visibleCount} / ${ASSETS.length} 个，${PACKAGES.length} 个素材包`;
  selectedAsset = defaultTile();
}

async function start() {
  bindEvents();
  renderSavedMaps();
  buildBoard();
  await loadLibrary();
  buildPurposeSelect();
  buildPackageSelect();
  buildCategories();
  fillDefaultTerrain();
  renderAssetList();
  if (selectedAsset) selectAsset(selectedAsset);
  openPendingWorldMap();
}

start().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  statusText.textContent = `素材库加载失败：${error.message}`;
});

function worldLandLayout(mapCount) {
  let cols = Math.max(42, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, mapCount) * 4.8)));
  let rows = Math.max(24, Math.ceil(cols * 0.56));
  let landCells = [];

    landCells = [];

    for (let y = 0; y < rows; y += 1) {

        const isLand = isEarthLandCell(x, y, cols, rows);
        const variant = Math.abs((x * 37 + y * 53 + x * y * 11) % 5);
        terrainCells.push({ x, y, type: isLand ? "land" : "ocean", variant });
        if (isLand) landCells.push({ x, y, variant });
      }
    }
    landCells.sort((a, b) => (a.y - b.y) || (a.x - b.x));
    if (landCells.length < mapCount) {
      cols += 4;
      rows = Math.ceil(cols * 0.56);
    }
  }
  return { cols, rows, landCells, terrainCells };
}

    ASSETS.find((asset) => asset.mode === "tile" && /grass|terrain|green/i.test(`${asset.id} ${asset.name}`)) ||

function buildBoard() {
  board.innerHTML = "";
  cells.length = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y += 1) {
    for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x += 1) {
      const cell = document.createElement("button");
      cell.type = "button";
      cell.className = "grid-cell";
      cell.dataset.x = String(x);
      cell.dataset.y = String(y);
      cell.style.left = `${x * CELL}px`;
      cell.style.top = `${y * CELL}px`;
      cell.title = `${x}, ${y}`;
      cell.addEventListener("click", () => placeSelected(x, y));
      cell.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        cell.classList.add("drop-target");
      });
      cell.addEventListener("dragleave", () => cell.classList.remove("drop-target"));
      cell.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        cell.classList.remove("drop-target");
        const asset = assetById(event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain"));
        if (asset) placeAsset(asset, x, y);
      });
      board.appendChild(cell);
      cells.push(cell);
    }
  }
}

function renderTerrain() {

    const y = Number(cell.dataset.y);

    cell.style.backgroundImage = asset ? `url("${assetUrl(asset)}")` : "";
  }
}

function buildPackageSelect() {
  const assets = visibleLibraryAssets();
  const counts = new Map();
  for (const asset of assets) counts.set(asset.package, (counts.get(asset.package) || 0) + 1);
  packageSelect.innerHTML = "";
  const all = document.createElement("option");
  all.value = "全部";
  all.textContent = `全部素材包 (${assets.length})`;
  packageSelect.appendChild(all);

  for (const pack of PACKAGES) {
    const count = counts.get(pack.name) || 0;
    if (count === 0) continue;
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = pack.name;
    option.textContent = `${pack.name} (${count})`;
    packageSelect.appendChild(option);
  }
  if (activePackage !== "全部" && !assets.some((asset) => asset.package === activePackage)) activePackage = "全部";
  packageSelect.value = activePackage;
}

function assetPurpose(asset) {
  const text = `${asset.package} ${asset.category} ${asset.id} ${asset.name}`.toLowerCase();
  const path = asset.id.toLowerCase();
  const tileNumber = Number((path.match(/(?:tile|maptile)_(\d+)/) || [])[1]);
  const hasTileNumber = Number.isFinite(tileNumber);

  if (/\/interface\//.test(path)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/\/weapons?\//.test(path)) return "武器弹药";
  if (/\/enemies?\//.test(path)) return "怪物敌人";
  if (/\/players?\//.test(path) || /\/characters?\//.test(path)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
  if (/\/backgrounds?\//.test(path)) return "背景素材";
  if (/\/ships?\//.test(path)) return "载具-飞船";

  if (asset.package === "favorite-map-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_MAP_PACK_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";

function removeOverlappingStamps(rect, exceptId = null) {
  let removed = 0;
  for (let index = stamps.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const stamp = stamps[index];
    if (stamp.id === exceptId) continue;
    if (!rectsOverlap(rect, stampRect(stamp))) continue;
    stamps.splice(index, 1);
    removed += 1;
  }
  return removed;
}

function renderStamps() {
  board.querySelectorAll(".stamp").forEach((node) => node.remove());
  for (const stamp of stamps) {
    const asset = stamp.assetId ? assetById(stamp.assetId) : null;
    if (!asset) continue;
    const image = document.createElement("img");
    image.className = `stamp${stamp.id === selectedStampId ? " selected" : ""}`;
    image.src = assetUrl(asset);
    image.alt = asset.name;
    image.draggable = true;
    image.dataset.id = String(stamp.id);
    image.style.left = `${stamp.x * CELL}px`;
    image.style.top = `${stamp.y * CELL}px`;
    image.style.width = `${stamp.w * CELL}px`;
    image.style.height = `${stamp.h * CELL}px`;
    image.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (selectedAsset && selectedAsset.id !== stamp.assetId) {
        placeAsset(selectedAsset, stamp.x, stamp.y);
        return;
      }
      selectedStampId = stamp.id;
      selectedAsset = asset;
      selectionLabel.textContent = `当前选择：${asset.name}`;
      statusText.textContent = `已选中 ${asset.name}，Delete 删除。`;
      renderAssetList();
      renderStamps();
    });
    image.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "copy";

    image.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {

      const nextAsset = assetById(event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain"));
      if (nextAsset) placeAsset(nextAsset, stamp.x, stamp.y);
    });

board.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();

board.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const rect = board.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = Math.floor((event.clientX - rect.left) / CELL);
  const y = Math.floor((event.clientY - rect.top) / CELL);
  if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= COLS || y >= ROWS) return;

  const stampId = Number(event.dataTransfer.getData("application/x-stamp-id"));
  if (stampId) {
    const stamp = stamps.find((item) => item.id === stampId);
    if (!stamp) return;
    const asset = assetById(stamp.assetId);
    if (!asset) return;
    const origin = clampOrigin(asset, x, y);
    const removed = removeOverlappingStamps({
      x: origin.x,
      y: origin.y,
      w: Math.max(1, stamp.w),
      h: Math.max(1, stamp.h),
    }, stamp.id);
    stamp.x = origin.x;
    stamp.y = origin.y;
    selectedStampId = stamp.id;
    renderStamps();
    statusText.textContent = removed > 0
      ? `已移动 ${asset.name}，并替换 ${removed} 个上层素材：${origin.x}, ${origin.y}`
      : `已移动 ${asset.name}：${origin.x}, ${origin.y}`;
    return;
  }

  const asset = assetById(event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain"));
  if (asset) placeAsset(asset, x, y);
});

function fillDefaultTerrain() {
  const asset = defaultTile();
  for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y += 1) {
    for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x += 1) {
      terrain[y][x] = asset?.id || null;
    }
  }
  renderTerrain();
  statusText.textContent = `已将地图版面铺满 ${asset?.name || "默认地块"}。`;
}

function chronologicalSavedMaps() {
  return savedMaps().sort((a, b) => {
    const left = String(a.createdAt || a.updatedAt || a.id || "");
    const right = String(b.createdAt || b.updatedAt || b.id || "");
    return left.localeCompare(right);
  });
}

function isWorldEnemyObject(object) {
  const asset = assetById(object.assetId);
  const purpose = asset ? assetPurpose(asset) : "";
  return purpose === "怪物敌人" || purpose === "出生点";
}

function worldLandLayout(mapCount) {
  let cols = Math.max(24, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, mapCount) * 2.2)));
  let rows = Math.max(16, Math.ceil(cols * 0.68));
  let landCells = [];
  while (landCells.length < mapCount) {
    landCells = [];
    const centerX = (cols - 1) / 2;
    const centerY = (rows - 1) / 2;
    const radiusX = Math.max(1, cols * 0.42);
    const radiusY = Math.max(1, rows * 0.36);
    for (let y = 0; y < rows; y += 1) {
      for (let x = 0; x < cols; x += 1) {
        const dx = (x - centerX) / radiusX;
        const dy = (y - centerY) / radiusY;

        if ((dx * dx + dy * dy) < 1.0 + bulge) {

    if (landCells.length < mapCount) {

      rows += 1;
    }
  }
  return { cols, rows, landCells };
}

async function loadLibrary() {
  loadHiddenLibraryAssets();
  const response = await fetch(`${MANIFEST_URL}?v=${encodeURIComponent(ASSET_CACHE_KEY)}`);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`无法读取 Kenney manifest: ${response.status}`);
  const manifest = await response.json();
  ASSETS = tinyOnlyAssets(manifest.assets || []);
  PACKAGES = tinyOnlyPackages(manifest.packages || [], ASSETS);
  if (!PACKAGES.some((pack) => pack.name === activePackage)) activePackage = PACKAGES[0]?.name || "全部";
  const visibleCount = visibleLibraryAssets().length;
  assetLibraryMeta.textContent = `Tiny、AI 与收藏素材 ${visibleCount} / ${ASSETS.length} 个，${PACKAGES.length} 个素材包`;
  selectedAsset = defaultTile();
}

async function start() {
  bindEvents();
  renderSavedMaps();
  buildBoard();
  await loadLibrary();
  buildPurposeSelect();
  buildPackageSelect();
  buildCategories();
  fillDefaultTerrain();
  renderAssetList();
  if (selectedAsset) selectAsset(selectedAsset);
  openPendingWorldMap();
}

start().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  statusText.textContent = `素材库加载失败：${error.message}`;
});

function moveWorldPlayer(dx, dy) {
  if (!worldLayoutState || !worldPlayerCell) return;
  const next = { x: worldPlayerCell.x + dx, y: worldPlayerCell.y + dy };
  if (!worldLayoutState.landKeys.has(worldCellKey(next.x, next.y))) return;
  worldPlayerCell = next;
  renderWorldPlayer();
}

[171] user: 现在仅仅进行玩法文字讨论：核心观点可以浓缩成一句话：

> 链上资产应该“强化游戏体验”，而不是“替代游戏体验”。

也就是说：

* 玩家先因为“好玩”留下
* 再因为“拥有感、稀缺性、社交价值”持续投入
* 而不是为了回本才玩

下面是几个关键结合点。

---

# 1. NFT 是“经历证明”，不是数值外挂

最好的链上资产：

不是“氪金更强”，
而是：

```text id="8xjwj0"
我参与过什么
我完成过什么
我创造过什么
```

例如：

* 首杀 Boss 纪念 NFT
* 限时赛季徽章
* 世界事件参与凭证
* 稀有剧情分支纪念

这样：

* 资产来自体验
* 不是来自充值

玩家会对“经历”产生情感价值。

---

# 2. 把 mint 设计成“游戏事件”

不要：

```text id="q8lxxn"
打怪随机掉 NFT
```

而要：

```text id="d9s32t"
完成高难挑战
→ 全服广播
→ mint 唯一道具
```

核心：

> mint 本身成为玩法高潮。

这样 NFT 是：

* 荣誉
* 社交资本
* 历史记录

而不仅是交易品。

---

# 3. 稀缺性来自“行为难度”，不是发行量

单纯限量没有意义。

真正有价值的是：

```text id="ovt6lz"
只有极少玩家能做到
```

例如：

* 无伤通关
* 竞速排名
* 高难 PVP
* 社交协作事件

即：

[
Value \propto Skill + Story + Scarcity
]

Value \propto Skill + Story + Scarcity

---

# 4. NFT 更适合“表达”而不是“压制”

推荐：

* 外观
* 动画
* 特效
* 宠物
* 身份标识
* 公会资产

不推荐：

* 超高攻击武器
* 永久数值碾压装备

因为：

> 表达会增强社交，
> 压制会毁掉生态。

---

# 5. 玩家创造内容（UGC）是最佳结合点

Web3 最大优势：

> 玩家真正拥有创造物。

例如：

* 玩家设计皮肤
* 地图
* MOD
* 剧情
* 建筑

优秀内容：

* 被游戏采用
* 自动 mint
* 创作者持续分成

这时链上资产：

不是金融工具，

而是：

> 玩家创造力的产权系统。

---

# 6. “可失去”比“可拥有”更重要

很多游戏资产没有意义，因为永远不会消失。

真正刺激的是：

* 争夺
* 风险
* 战争
* 掠夺
* 消耗

例如：

* 公会领土 NFT
* 可被夺取资源
* 战争赛季

这样资产会真正嵌入玩法循环。

---

# 7. 最重要原则

一个很关键的设计顺序：

```text id="78h0bl"
玩法循环
→ 社交关系
→ 长期目标
→ 最后才是 Token/NFT
```

而不是反过来。

---

# 最终简化成一句产品哲学

## 错误方向

```text id="3oj5mk"
因为 NFT 所以玩游戏
```

## 正确方向

```text id="6qaz2h"
因为游戏好玩
所以 NFT 有意义
```

真正成功的链游里：

* NFT 是“情感放大器”
* 是“历史记录”
* 是“身份系统”
* 是“社交资产”

而不是提款机。结合本编辑器游戏如何实现；给出简要建议

[171] user: 现在仅仅进行玩法文字讨论：核心观点可以浓缩成一句话：

> 链上资产应该“强化游戏体验”，而不是“替代游戏体验”。

也就是说：

* 玩家先因为“好玩”留下
* 再因为“拥有感、稀缺性、社交价值”持续投入
* 而不是为了回本才玩

下面是几个关键结合点。

---

# 1. NFT 是“经历证明”，不是数值外挂

最好的链上资产：

不是“氪金更强”，
而是：

```text id="8xjwj0"
我参与过什么
我完成过什么
我创造过什么
```

例如：

* 首杀 Boss 纪念 NFT
* 限时赛季徽章
* 世界事件参与凭证
* 稀有剧情分支纪念

这样：

* 资产来自体验
* 不是来自充值

玩家会对“经历”产生情感价值。

---

# 2. 把 mint 设计成“游戏事件”

不要：

```text id="q8lxxn"
打怪随机掉 NFT
```

而要：

```text id="d9s32t"
完成高难挑战
→ 全服广播
→ mint 唯一道具
```

核心：

> mint 本身成为玩法高潮。

这样 NFT 是：

* 荣誉
* 社交资本
* 历史记录

而不仅是交易品。

---

# 3. 稀缺性来自“行为难度”，不是发行量

单纯限量没有意义。

真正有价值的是：

```text id="ovt6lz"
只有极少玩家能做到
```

例如：

* 无伤通关
* 竞速排名
* 高难 PVP
* 社交协作事件

即：

[
Value \propto Skill + Story + Scarcity
]

Value \propto Skill + Story + Scarcity

---

# 4. NFT 更适合“表达”而不是“压制”

推荐：

* 外观
* 动画
* 特效
* 宠物
* 身份标识
* 公会资产

不推荐：

* 超高攻击武器
* 永久数值碾压装备

因为：

> 表达会增强社交，
> 压制会毁掉生态。

---

# 5. 玩家创造内容（UGC）是最佳结合点

Web3 最大优势：

> 玩家真正拥有创造物。

例如：

* 玩家设计皮肤
* 地图
* MOD
* 剧情
* 建筑

优秀内容：

* 被游戏采用
* 自动 mint
* 创作者持续分成

这时链上资产：

不是金融工具，

而是：

> 玩家创造力的产权系统。

---

# 6. “可失去”比“可拥有”更重要

很多游戏资产没有意义，因为永远不会消失。

真正刺激的是：

* 争夺
* 风险
* 战争
* 掠夺
* 消耗

例如：

* 公会领土 NFT
* 可被夺取资源
* 战争赛季

这样资产会真正嵌入玩法循环。

---

# 7. 最重要原则

一个很关键的设计顺序：

```text id="78h0bl"
玩法循环
→ 社交关系
→ 长期目标
→ 最后才是 Token/NFT
```

而不是反过来。

---

# 最终简化成一句产品哲学

## 错误方向

```text id="3oj5mk"
因为 NFT 所以玩游戏
```

## 正确方向

```text id="6qaz2h"
因为游戏好玩
所以 NFT 有意义
```

真正成功的链游里：

* NFT 是“情感放大器”
* 是“历史记录”
* 是“身份系统”

---
name: browser
description: "Browser automation for the Codex in-app browser. Use to open, navigate, inspect, test, click, type, screenshot, or verify local targets such as localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, file://, the current in-app browser tab, and websites shown side by side inside Codex."
---

# Browser

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state. After setup, select the `iab` browser.

Keep browser work in the background by default.

Show the browser when the user's request is primarily to put a page in front of them or let them watch the interaction, such as "open localhost:3000", "go to the docs page", "take me to the PR", "show me the current tab", or "keep the browser open while you test checkout".

Do not show the browser when navigation is only a means to answer a question or verify behavior, such as "check localhost:3000 and tell me whether login works", "inspect the docs page and summarize what changed", or "verify the modal still opens correctly". Localhost targets and ordinary page navigation do not by themselves require visibility.

When the browser should be visible to the user, actually present it with `await (await browser.capabilities.get("visibility")).set(true)`.

If this plugin is listed as available in the session, treat that as mandatory reading before browser work. Open and follow this skill before saying that Browser is unavailable and before falling back to standalone Playwright or Computer Use.

Do not skip this skill just because Computer Use MCP tool calls are directly visible or appear easier to invoke. The presence of Computer Use tools is not evidence that Computer Use is the preferred browser surface.

Before using this skill for the first time in the current conversation context, read<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="1670" />.get("other-tab-id");
await detailsTab.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await detailsTab.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await detailsTab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

BAD: refetching the same tab into a new variable just to avoid reuse:
```js
const tab2 = await browser.tabs.get("tab-id");
await tab2.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab2.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab2.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

BAD: wrapping a whole cell in block scope when there is no specific naming collision to solve:
```js
{
  const snap = await tab.playwright.domSnapshot();
  console.log(snap);
}
```

BAD: redeclaring an existing variable (`const tab = ` will fail):
```js
const tab = await browser.tabs.get("tab-id");
await tab.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

GOOD: if you only need a snapshot once, avoid creating a new reusable variable name for it:
```js
console.log(await tab.playwright.domSnapshot());
```

#### Files

In `node_repl` you can use Node filesystem libraries when needed.

For file operations, prefer the Node runtime libraries directly:
```js
const fs = await import("node:fs/promises");

// write a file
await fs.writeFile("hello.txt", "Hello world");

// read a file
const contents = await fs.readFile("hello.txt", "utf-8");
```

#### Browser interactions

Use the guarded first-browser-cell pattern above when starting browser work. It prepares the browser runtime and top-level `agent` object for browser work.

## API Use Behavior

The ability to interact directly with the browser is exposed through the `browser-client` runtime via the `agent.browsers.*` API.

BAD: refetching the same tab into a new variable just to avoid reuse:
```js
const tab2 = await browser.tabs.get("tab-id");
await tab2.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab2.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab2.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

BAD: wrapping a whole cell in block scope when there is no specific naming collision to solve:
```js
{
  const snap = await tab.playwright.domSnapshot();
  console.log(snap);
}
```

BAD: redeclaring an existing variable (`const tab = ` will fail):
```js
const tab = await browser.tabs.get("tab-id");
await tab.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

GOOD: if you only need a snapshot once, avoid creating a new reusable variable name for it:
```js
console.log(await tab.playwright.domSnapshot());
```

#### Files

In `node_repl` you can use Node filesystem libraries when needed.

For file operations, prefer the Node runtime libraries directly:
```js
const fs = await import("node:fs/promises");

// write a file
await fs.writeFile("hello.txt", "Hello world");

// read a file
const contents = await fs.readFile("hello.txt", "utf-8");
```

#### Browser interactions

Use the guarded first-browser-cell pattern above when starting browser work. It prepares the browser runtime and top-level `agent` object for browser work.

## API Use Behavior

The ability to interact directly with the browser is exposed through the `browser-client` runtime via the `agent.browsers.*` API.

[171] user: 现在仅仅进行玩法文字讨论：核心观点可以浓缩成一句话：

> 链上资产应该“强化游戏体验”，而不是“替代游戏体验”。

也就是说：

* 玩家先因为“好玩”留下
* 再因为“拥有感、稀缺性、社交价值”持续投入
* 而不是为了回本才玩

下面是几个关键结合点。

---

# 1. NFT 是“经历证明”，不是数值外挂

最好的链上资产：

不是“氪金更强”，
而是：

```text id="8xjwj0"
我参与过什么
我完成过什么
我创造过什么
```

例如：

* 首杀 Boss 纪念 NFT
* 限时赛季徽章
* 世界事件参与凭证
* 稀有剧情分支纪念

这样：

* 资产来自体验
* 不是来自充值

玩家会对“经历”产生情感价值。

---

# 2. 把 mint 设计成“游戏事件”

不要：

```text id="q8lxxn"
打怪随机掉 NFT
```

而要：

```text id="d9s32t"
完成高难挑战
→ 全服广播
→ mint 唯一道具
```

核心：

> mint 本身成为玩法高潮。

这样 NFT 是：

* 荣誉
* 社交资本
* 历史记录

而不仅是交易品。

---

# 3. 稀缺性来自“行为难度”，不是发行量

单纯限量没有意义。

真正有价值的是：

```text id="ovt6lz"
只有极少玩家能做到
```

例如：

* 无伤通关
* 竞速排名
* 高难 PVP
* 社交协作事件

即：

[
Value \propto Skill + Story + Scarcity
]

Value \propto Skill + Story + Scarcity

---

# 4. NFT 更适合“表达”而不是“压制”

推荐：

* 外观
* 动画
* 特效
* 宠物
* 身份标识
* 公会资产

不推荐：

* 超高攻击武器
* 永久数值碾压装备

因为：

> 表达会增强社交，
> 压制会毁掉生态。

---

# 5. 玩家创造内容（UGC）是最佳结合点

Web3 最大优势：

> 玩家真正拥有创造物。

例如：

* 玩家设计皮肤
* 地图
* MOD
* 剧情
* 建筑

优秀内容：

* 被游戏采用
* 自动 mint
* 创作者持续分成

这时链上资产：

不是金融工具，

而是：

> 玩家创造力的产权系统。

---

# 6. “可失去”比“可拥有”更重要

很多游戏资产没有意义，因为永远不会消失。

真正刺激的是：

* 争夺
* 风险
* 战争
* 掠夺
* 消耗

例如：

* 公会领土 NFT
* 可被夺取资源
* 战争赛季

这样资产会真正嵌入玩法循环。

---

# 7. 最重要原则

一个很关键的设计顺序：

```text id="78h0bl"
玩法循环
→ 社交关系
→ 长期目标
→ 最后才是 Token/NFT
```

而不是反过来。

---

# 最终简化成一句产品哲学

## 错误方向

```text id="3oj5mk"
因为 NFT 所以玩游戏
```

## 正确方向

```text id="6qaz2h"
因为游戏好玩
所以 NFT 有意义
```

真正成功的链游里：

* NFT 是“情感放大器”
* 是“历史记录”
* 是“身份系统”
* 是“社交资产”

而不是提款机。结合本编辑器游戏如何实现；给出简要建议

func _remove_story_npc(npc: Dictionary) -> void:
	var body: Node = npc.get("body", null)
	if body != null and is_instance_valid(body):
		body.queue_free()
	active_npcs.erase(npc)

func _asset_id_texture_path(asset_id: String) -> String:
	if asset_id == "":
		return ""
	var manifest := _json_dict(KENNEY_MAP_MANIFEST_JSON)
	for item in manifest.get("assets", []):
		if typeof(item) == TYPE_DICTIONARY and String(item.get("id", "")) == asset_id:
			var rel_path := String(item.get("file", ""))
			if rel_path != "":
				return "res://" + rel_path
	return ""

func _create_movable_npc_body(visual_node: Sprite2D, world_pos: Vector2, node_offset: Vector2) -> CharacterBody2D:
	var body := CharacterBody2D.new()
	body.name = "MovableNPC_CharacterBody2D"
	body.position = world_pos
	body.collision_layer = 1
	body.collision_mask = 1
	body.z_index = visual_node.z_index
	map_root.add_child(body)
	visual_node.get_parent().remove_child(visual_node)
	body.add_child(visual_node)
	visual_node.position = node_offset

	var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
	var shape := CircleShape2D.new()
	shape.radius = max(5.0, active_cell_px * 0.35)
	collision.shape = shape
	body.add_child(collision)
	return body

+func _is_actor_uid_alive(uid: int) -> bool:

+	return false

+func _story_ability_alive(ability_id: String) -> bool:

[171] user: 现在仅仅进行玩法文字讨论：核心观点可以浓缩成一句话：

> 链上资产应该“强化游戏体验”，而不是“替代游戏体验”。

也就是说：

* 玩家先因为“好玩”留下
* 再因为“拥有感、稀缺性、社交价值”持续投入
* 而不是为了回本才玩

下面是几个关键结合点。

---

# 1. NFT 是“经历证明”，不是数值外挂

最好的链上资产：

不是“氪金更强”，
而是：

```text id="8xjwj0"
我参与过什么
我完成过什么
我创造过什么
```

例如：

* 首杀 Boss 纪念 NFT
* 限时赛季徽章
* 世界事件参与凭证
* 稀有剧情分支纪念

这样：

* 资产来自体验
* 不是来自充值

玩家会对“经历”产生情感价值。

---

# 2. 把 mint 设计成“游戏事件”

不要：

```text id="q8lxxn"
打怪随机掉 NFT
```

而要：

```text id="d9s32t"
完成高难挑战
→ 全服广播
→ mint 唯一道具
```

核心：

> mint 本身成为玩法高潮。

这样 NFT 是：

* 荣誉
* 社交资本
* 历史记录

而不仅是交易品。

---

# 3. 稀缺性来自“行为难度”，不是发行量

单纯限量没有意义。

真正有价值的是：

```text id="ovt6lz"
只有极少玩家能做到
```

例如：

* 无伤通关
* 竞速排名
* 高难 PVP
* 社交协作事件

即：

[
Value \propto Skill + Story + Scarcity
]

Value \propto Skill + Story + Scarcity

---

# 4. NFT 更适合“表达”而不是“压制”

推荐：

* 外观
* 动画
* 特效
* 宠物
* 身份标识
* 公会资产

不推荐：

* 超高攻击武器
* 永久数值碾压装备

因为：

> 表达会增强社交，
> 压制会毁掉生态。

---

# 5. 玩家创造内容（UGC）是最佳结合点

Web3 最大优势：

> 玩家真正拥有创造物。

例如：

* 玩家设计皮肤
* 地图
* MOD
* 剧情
* 建筑

优秀内容：

* 被游戏采用
* 自动 mint
* 创作者持续分成

这时链上资产：

不是金融工具，

而是：

> 玩家创造力的产权系统。

---

# 6. “可失去”比“可拥有”更重要

很多游戏资产没有意义，因为永远不会消失。

真正刺激的是：

* 争夺
* 风险
* 战争
* 掠夺
* 消耗

例如：

* 公会领土 NFT
* 可被夺取资源
* 战争赛季

这样资产会真正嵌入玩法循环。

---

# 7. 最重要原则

一个很关键的设计顺序：

```text id="78h0bl"
玩法循环
→ 社交关系
→ 长期目标
→ 最后才是 Token/NFT
```

而不是反过来。

---

# 最终简化成一句产品哲学

## 错误方向

```text id="3oj5mk"
因为 NFT 所以玩游戏
```

## 正确方向

```text id="6qaz2h"
因为游戏好玩
所以 NFT 有意义
```

真正成功的链游里：

* NFT 是“情感放大器”
* 是“历史记录”
* 是“身份系统”
* 是“社交资产”

而不是提款机。结合本编辑器游戏如何实现；给出简要建议

	var manifest := _json_dict(KENNEY_MAP_MANIFEST_JSON)

	return ""

func _create_movable_npc_body(visual_node: Sprite2D, world_pos: Vector2, node_offset: Vector2) -> CharacterBody2D:
	var body := CharacterBody2D.new()
	body.name = "MovableNPC_CharacterBody2D"
	body.position = world_pos
	body.collision_layer = 1
	body.collision_mask = 1
	body.z_index = visual_node.z_index
	map_root.add_child(body)
	visual_node.get_parent().remove_child(visual_node)
	body.add_child(visual_node)
	visual_node.position = node_offset

	var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
	var shape := CircleShape2D.new()
	shape.radius = max(5.0, active_cell_px * 0.35)
	collision.shape = shape
	body.add_child(collision)
	return body

func _start_next_story_event() -> void:
	var events := _story_event_pool()
	if story_event_index >= events.size():
		return
	active_story_event = events[story_event_index]
	story_event_index += 1
	var npc := _spawn_story_event_npc(active_story_event)
	if npc.is_empty():
		active_story_event = {}
		story_event_next_half_day = _next_half_day_after_current()
		return
	active_story_npc_uid = int(npc.get("uid", -1))

# Browser

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state. After setup, select the `iab` browser.

Keep browser work in the background by default.

Show the browser when the user's request is primarily to put a page in front of them or let them watch the interaction, such as "open localhost:3000", "go to the docs page", "take me to the PR", "show me the current tab", or "keep the browser open while you test checkout".

Do not show the browser when navigation is only a means to answer a question or verify behavior, such as "check localhost:3000 and tell me whether login works", "inspect the docs page and summarize what changed", or "verify the modal still opens correctly". Localhost targets and ordinary page navigation do not by themselves require visibility.

When the browser should be visible to the user, actually present it with `await (await browser.capabilities.get("visibility")).set(true)`.

If this plugin is listed as available in the session, treat that as mandatory reading before browser work. Open and follow this skill before saying that Browser is unavailable and before falling back to standalone Playwright or Computer Use.

Do not skip this skill just because Computer Use MCP tool calls are directly visible or appear easier to invoke. The presence of Computer Use tools is not evidence that Computer Use is the preferred browser surface.

Before using this skill for the first time in the current conversation context, read<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="1505" />llPage: false }));
```

GOOD: if you intentionally want the main `tab` variable to point at a different tab later, declare it once with `let` and then reassign it:
```js
let tab = await browser.tabs.new();
await tab.goto("https://news.ycombinator.com");

tab = await browser.tabs.get("other-tab-id");
await tab.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

GOOD: if you need both tabs live at once, give the second tab a new descriptive variable:
```js
const detailsTab = await browser.tabs.get("other-tab-id");
await detailsTab.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await detailsTab.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await detailsTab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

BAD: refetching the same tab into a new variable just to avoid reuse:
```js
const tab2 = await browser.tabs.get("tab-id");
await tab2.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab2.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab2.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

BAD: wrapping a whole cell in block scope when there is no specific naming collision to solve:
```js
{
  const snap = await tab.playwright.domSnapshot();
  console.log(snap);
}
```

BAD: redeclaring an existing variable (`const tab = ` will fail):
```js
const tab = await browser.tabs.get("tab-id");
await tab.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

GOOD: if you only need a snapshot once, avoid creating a new reusable variable name for it:
```js
console.log(await tab.playwright.domSnapshot());
```

await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

GOOD: if you need both tabs live at once, give the second tab a new descriptive variable:
```js
const detailsTab = await browser.tabs.get("other-tab-id");
await detailsTab.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await detailsTab.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await detailsTab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

BAD: refetching the same tab into a new variable just to avoid reuse:
```js
const tab2 = await browser.tabs.get("tab-id");
await tab2.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab2.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab2.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

BAD: wrapping a whole cell in block scope when there is no specific naming collision to solve:
```js
{
  const snap = await tab.playwright.domSnapshot();
  console.log(snap);
}
```

BAD: redeclaring an existing variable (`const tab = ` will fail):
```js
const tab = await browser.tabs.get("tab-id");
await tab.playwright.getByText("Interesting Post", { exact: false }).click();
await tab.playwright.waitForLoadState({ state: "load", timeoutMs: 10000 });
await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab.screenshot({ fullPage: false }));
```

GOOD: if you only need a snapshot once, avoid creating a new reusable variable name for it:
```js
console.log(await tab.playwright.domSnapshot());
```

# Browser

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state. After setup, select the `iab` browser.

Keep browser work in the background by default.

Show the browser when the user's request is primarily to put a page in front of them or let them watch the interaction, such as "open localhost:3000", "go to the docs page", "take me to the PR", "show me the current tab", or "keep the browser open while you test checkout".

Do not show the browser when navigation is only a means to answer a question or verify behavior, such as "check localhost:3000 and tell me whether login works", "inspect the docs page and summarize what changed", or "verify the modal still opens correctly". Localhost targets and ordinary page navigation do not by themselves require visibility.

When the browser should be visible to the user, actually present it with `await (await browser.capabilities.get("visibility")).set(true)`.

If this plugin is listed as available in the session, treat that as mandatory reading before browser work. Open and follow this skill before saying that Browser is unavailable and before falling back to standalone Playwright or Computer Use.

Do not skip this skill just because Computer Use MCP tool calls are directly visible or appear easier to invoke. The presence of Computer Use tools is not evidence that Computer Use is the preferred browser surface.

# Image Generation Skill

Generates or edits images for the current project (for example website assets, game assets, UI mockups, product mockups, wireframes, logo design, photorealistic images, or infographics).

## Top-level modes and rules

This skill has exactly two top-level modes:

- **Default built-in tool mode (preferred):** built-in `image_gen` tool for normal image generation, editing, and simple transparent-image requests. Does not require `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- **Fallback CLI mode:** `scripts/image_gen.py` CLI. Use when the user explicitly asks for the CLI/API/model path, or after the user explicitly confirms a true model-native transparency fallback with `gpt-image-1.5`. Requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

Within CLI fallback, the CLI exposes three subcommands:

- `generate`
- `edit`
- `generate-batch`

Rules:
- Use the built-in `image_gen` tool by default for normal image generation and editing requests.
- Do not switch to CLI fallback for ordinary quality, size, or file-path control.
- If the user explicitly asks for a transparent image/background, stay on built-in `image_gen` first: prompt for a flat removable chroma-key background, then remove it locally with the installed helper at `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/imagegen/scripts/remove_ch<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5027" /> chroma-key removal and optional downscaling:
```bash
uv pip install pillow
```

Portability note:
- If you are using the installed skill outside this repo, install dependencies into that environment with its package manager.
- In uv-managed environments, `uv pip install ...` remains the preferred path.

### Environment
- `OPENAI_API_KEY` must be set for live API calls.
- Do not ask the user for `OPENAI_API_KEY` when using the built-in `image_gen` tool.
- Never ask the user to paste the full key in chat. Ask them to set it locally and confirm when ready.

If the key is missing, give the user these steps:
1. Create an API key in the OpenAI platform UI: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
2. Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` as an environment variable in their system.
3. Offer to guide them through setting the environment variable for their OS/shell if needed.

If installation is not possible in this environment, tell the user which dependency is missing and how to install it into their active environment.

### Script-mode notes
- CLI commands + examples: `references/cli.md`
- API parameter quick reference: `references/image-api.md`
- Network approvals / sandbox settings for CLI mode: `references/codex-network.md`

## Reference map
- `references/prompting.md`: shared prompting principles for both modes.
- `references/sample-prompts.md`: shared copy/paste prompt recipes for both modes.
- `references/cli.md`: fallback-only CLI usage via `scripts/image_gen.py`.
- `references/image-api.md`: fallback-only API/CLI parameter reference.
- `references/codex-network.md`: fallback-only network/sandbox troubleshooting for CLI mode.
- `scripts/image_gen.py`: fallback-only CLI implementation. Do not load or use it unless the user explicitly chooses CLI mode or explicitly confirms a transparent request's true CLI transparency fallback.
- `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/imagegen/scripts/remove_chroma_key.py`: local post-processing helper for built-in transparent-image requests.

# Image Generation Skill

Generates or edits images for the current project (for example website assets, game assets, UI mockups, product mockups, wireframes, logo design, photorealistic images, or infographics).

## Top-level modes and rules

This skill has exactly two top-level modes:

- **Default built-in tool mode (preferred):** built-in `image_gen` tool for normal image generation, editing, and simple transparent-image requests. Does not require `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- **Fallback CLI mode:** `scripts/image_gen.py` CLI. Use when the user explicitly asks for the CLI/API/model path, or after the user explicitly confirms a true model-native transparency fallback with `gpt-image-1.5`. Requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

Within CLI fallback, the CLI exposes three subcommands:

- `generate`
- `edit`
- `generate-batch`

Rules:
- Use the built-in `image_gen` tool by default for normal image generation and editing requests.
- Do not switch to CLI fallback for ordinary quality, size, or file-path control.
- If the user explicitly asks for a transparent image/background, stay on built-in `image_gen` first: prompt for a flat removable chroma-key background, then remove it locally with the installed helper at `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/imagegen/scripts/remove_ch<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5027" /> chroma-key removal and optional downscaling:
```bash
uv pip install pillow
```

Portability note:
- If you are using the installed skill outside this repo, install dependencies into that environment with its package manager.
- In uv-managed environments, `uv pip install ...` remains the preferred path.

### Environment
- `OPENAI_API_KEY` must be set for live API calls.
- Do not ask the user for `OPENAI_API_KEY` when using the built-in `image_gen` tool.
- Never ask the user to paste the full key in chat. Ask them to set it locally and confirm when ready.

If the key is missing, give the user these steps:
1. Create an API key in the OpenAI platform UI: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
2. Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` as an environment variable in their system.
3. Offer to guide them through setting the environment variable for their OS/shell if needed.

If installation is not possible in this environment, tell the user which dependency is missing and how to install it into their active environment.

### Script-mode notes
- CLI commands + examples: `references/cli.md`
- API parameter quick reference: `references/image-api.md`
- Network approvals / sandbox settings for CLI mode: `references/codex-network.md`

## Reference map
- `references/prompting.md`: shared prompting principles for both modes.
- `references/sample-prompts.md`: shared copy/paste prompt recipes for both modes.
- `references/cli.md`: fallback-only CLI usage via `scripts/image_gen.py`.
- `references/image-api.md`: fallback-only API/CLI parameter reference.
- `references/codex-network.md`: fallback-only network/sandbox troubleshooting for CLI mode.
- `scripts/image_gen.py`: fallback-only CLI implementation. Do not load or use it unless the user explicitly chooses CLI mode or explicitly confirms a transparent request's true CLI transparency fallback.
- `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/imagegen/scripts/remove_chroma_key.py`: local post-processing helper for built-in transparent-image requests.
